newsitem.title: USA: New Jersey biker pleads guilty to murdering cop.
newsitem.headline: New Jersey biker pleads guilty to murdering cop.

text.p: A New Jersey court Tuesday accepted the guilty plea of a motorcycle gang member who said he shot a policeman dead in 1995.
Prosecutors said they would seek the death penalty in the case of Robert Simon, who interrupted jury selection Monday to say he wanted to plead guilty to the murder of Police Sgt. Ippolito Gonzalez.
A Superior Court judge accepted the guilty plea Tuesday after giving Simon a day to reconsider his decision.
He is standing trial with another motorcycle gang member, Charles Staples.
Simon, 43, met up with Staples, 37, only days after leaving a Pennsylvania prison where he was paroled from a murder sentence. Both were members of the Warlocks motorcycle club.

A condition of his parole was that Simon avoid gang activity. Eleven weeks later, the pair were arrested for gunning down Gonzalez during a routine traffic stop in Franklin Township about 20 miles southeast of Philadelphia.
The incident set off an intense review of parole procedures in both Pennsylvania and New Jersey.
